clean_check:
Feasibility: All proposed changes align with existing React/TypeScript/Vite stack, React Router routing, localStorage mock pattern (separate key 'nosurprise.microloan.v1' avoids collision with 'nosurprise.mock.v2'), RequireAuth admin guard, and Layout navigation patterns. Separate formatRub is necessary and minimal since format.ts hardcodes BYN. New mock helper with error propagation is required because current save() suppresses localStorage errors. New domain types in types.ts/mock.ts properly separate microloan from mortgage domain. FileInput component fills a genuine gap in ui.tsx. Double-submit via isSubmitting flag is standard React pattern. No backend changes required.

Proportionality: The 5 routes + nav form one cohesive demo flow: calculator → application → user status ↔ admin applications ↔ admin types. No independently valuable outcomes are bundled; each screen feeds the next. No hidden prerequisites beyond existing VITE_USE_MOCKS=true. No migration, API compatibility, or coupling work since backend untouched.

Overengineering: No redundant components, premature abstractions, or gold-plating. formatRub is a single function, not a configuration system. Mock helper adapts existing pattern for error propagation only. FileInput shows filename only — no upload logic. isSubmitting is a boolean flag, not an idempotency key system. Types are domain-specific, not generic. No custom mechanism duplicates existing project modules.

Underengineering: Spec covers localStorage write failures (show error, rollback UI), double-submit protection, no-active-products state, form validation (required fields + file), admin auth via existing RequireAuth, admin validation with localStorage error handling, file non-persistence. Edge cases addressed: boundary amounts/terms, grace period boundaries, mathematical rounding, deactivated types preserving history. Rare demo-only gaps (concurrent tab conflicts, quota exceeded, rapid admin changes) are acceptable limitations for internal testing.

Better alternative: No demonstrably simpler approach with same outcome. Mortgage calculator UI components (ResultSummary, PaymentChart, ScheduleTable) are mortgage-specific (monthly amortization) — microloan uses single payment, different formula. Extending Api interface would conflate domains; separate types maintain clarity. Adapting mock.ts pattern with separate storage key and error propagation is the appropriate reuse level.
summary: The updated user-spec is feasible, proportionate, and architecturally consistent. All proposed changes are simple local additions that integrate cleanly with existing patterns without over- or under-engineering. No better alternative exists within the current project that achieves the approved demo outcome with less complexity.
